sand_monster.reviewed_by: Codex: direct final native/comparison/world/icon inspection; not user sign-off
sand_monster.notes: Own authored geometry/UV/pixels/rig/clips. Original narrow/tall sand and broader stone/dirt silhouettes retained. Geological material fields replace copied block tiles. First pale stone patches and oversized eyes refined before acceptance. 17 genuinely weighted joints, knees/elbows/feet/hands/spine/head/jaw. Split proximal/distal limb cubes preserve both attachment rings under full skinning. Required idle/walk/run/punch retained; no original die capability to remove. Stance direction, swing clearance, loop, contact and actual forward strike tested. Walk/Run playback calibrated to actual foot retreat at runtime walk reference; full engine travelScale clamp range and other species cadence audit remain R6. Gameplay bounds/speeds/habitat unchanged. Native originals also captured; sand baseline black faces reproduce in Release and are not copied. No R6 or performance PASS claimed.
